summary: Codex CLI (openai/codex) is a Rust coding agent. Its CLI is the codex-rs workspace crate codex-cli (binary `codex`); the npm package in codex-cli/ only wraps prebuilt binaries. The non-interactive entrypoint is `codex exec [OPTIONS] -- "<prompt>"`, which runs one headless session. `--json` streams JSONL events, `-o FILE` writes the final message, `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox` turns off approvals and the sandbox, `--skip-git-repo-check` allows non-git dirs, and CODEX_HOME holds the config and the rollout trajectories. Compiling the workspace needs more than 8 GB of RAM, and the previous build was OOM-killed. The overlay therefore installs the official statically linked musl `codex` binary that upstream CI builds from this workspace (GitHub release rust-v0.156.1, x86_64 or aarch64 chosen by `uname -m`). The repo source is still COPYed to /opt/harness/src, and `--build-arg CODEX_INSTALL=source` compiles from source on a large builder instead. Codex calls models only through the OpenAI Responses API (`POST <base_url>/responses`, SSE); `wire_api="chat"` is rejected. So the run command starts a stdlib-Python shim on 127.0.0.1:8790 using a uv-managed Python under /opt/harness. The shim translates Responses requests into streaming chat-completions calls to $PROXY_URL/v1/chat/completions and converts the results back. Function tools map 1:1, and freeform custom tools such as apply_patch become functions with a single `input` string. Codex reaches the shim through a custom provider in CODEX_HOME/config.toml, with model gpt-5.5.
run_command:
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/harness/bin:$PATH
OUT_DIR=/out; mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || { OUT_DIR=/tmp/out; mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"; }
export CODEX_HOME="${CODEX_HOME:-$OUT_DIR/codex-home}"; mkdir -p "$CODEX_HOME"
SHIM_PORT="${CODEX_SHIM_PORT:-8790}"
UPSTREAM="${CODEX_PROXY_UPSTREAM:-${PROXY_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8080}}"
MODEL="${CODEX_MODEL:-gpt-5.5}"
cat > "$CODEX_HOME/config.toml" <<EOF
model = "$MODEL"
model_provider = "proxy"
[analytics]
enabled = false
[model_providers.proxy]
name = "proxy"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:$SHIM_PORT/v1"
env_key = "PROXY_API_KEY"
wire_api = "responses"
request_max_retries = 2
stream_max_retries = 2
stream_idle_timeout_ms = 900000
EOF
/opt/harness/bin/harness-python /opt/harness/bin/codex-responses-shim.py --listen "127.0.0.1:$SHIM_PORT" --upstream "$UPSTREAM" --log "$OUT_DIR/shim.log" --dump "$OUT_DIR/shim_traffic.jsonl" &
SHIM_PID=$!
for _ in $(seq 1 100); do curl -fs "http://127.0.0.1:$SHIM_PORT/healthz" >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 0.1; done
/opt/harness/bin/codex exec --json --color never --skip-git-repo-check --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox --cd "$PWD" -m "$MODEL" -o "$OUT_DIR/last_message.txt" -- "$TASK" </dev/null | tee "$OUT_DIR/events.jsonl"
RC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
kill "$SHIM_PID" 2>/dev/null; wait "$SHIM_PID" 2>/dev/null
exit "$RC"
notes: FIX: the previous recipe compiled codex-rs with cargo during the image build and was OOM-killed ("cannot allocate memory") on the 7.7 GB builder. The rustc jobs for codex-core and codex-tui, plus the final link, each need about 5 GB or more. The overlay now installs, by default, the official statically linked musl `codex` binary from the upstream GitHub release rust-v0.156.1. Upstream CI builds it from this same codex-rs workspace, and the arch is picked by `uname -m`. The build now takes about 1 minute and has no compiler toolchain. The repo source is still COPYed to /opt/harness/src. `--build-arg CODEX_INSTALL=source` (with CARGO_JOBS/CARGO_PROFILE) compiles from source on builders with 16 GB or more, and `--build-arg CODEX_RELEASE=<tag>` pins a different release. Note: this checkout's Cargo version is 0.0.0 (unreleased main), so the binary is the latest release, not bit-identical to HEAD. VERIFIED locally (Docker Desktop aarch64, 7.7 GB): (1) the overlay built FROM python:3.12-slim-bookworm. A task ran with `docker run --network none` against an in-container chat-completions mock: codex ran shell_command and apply_patch through the shim, wrote shim_test.txt and shim_patch.txt in /work, and exited 0. (2) The overlay built FROM buildpack-deps:jammy, and the check command passed under `bash -lc` (codex-cli 0.156.1, check-ok). Artifacts under /out: codex-home/sessions/**/rollout-*.jsonl (codex's own trajectory), events.jsonl, last_message.txt, shim.log, shim_traffic.jsonl. The Dockerfile uses a COPY heredoc for the shim, which needs BuildKit (the default in Docker 23+). Design notes are unchanged: codex is Responses-only (wire_api="chat" is rejected), hence the loopback shim. gpt-5.5 is used because its bundled metadata uses plain function tools. `[analytics] enabled=false` disables telemetry, and the sandbox is bypassed because the container is the sandbox.
